en.title: Record physical verification of recent screen, UI and World3D changes
en.body: The consolidated report inventories 32 merged Claude-named PRs through #516, records Windows RTX 5090 Laptop and Fold7 Adreno 830 hardware observations, preserves the original views-helper focus assertion failure and identifies remaining platform and formal performance limits.

zh.title: 补充近期屏幕、UI 与 World3D 真机验收
zh.body: 汇总覆盖至 #516 的 32 个 Claude 来源分支，记录 Windows RTX 5090 Laptop 与 Fold7 Adreno 830 实测，保留原视图辅助测试焦点断言失败及诊断，明确平台与正式性能待验收范围。
